# Human review — Antara Conference, April 15, 2027
All times EDT. No agenda changes, guest exceptions, address changes, or hotel accommodations are approved by this run. Use the retained drafts for human dispatch. Inbox citations below refer to `data/inbox/NNN.txt`.

Paula Ríos: before doors open, either approve Mateo Villalobos starting on time with those present and bringing Ana Lucía in at a suitable transition, or approve a different contingency. The official Spanish-language slot remains 16:10–17:10. Three direct heads-up drafts are ready for the organizer (English), Mateo (Spanish), and panel lead Sofía Vargas (Spanish); send them manually.
